newsitem.title: UK: Charterhouse Communications floats on AIM.
newsitem.headline: Charterhouse Communications floats on AIM.

text.p: Charterhouse Communications Plc, a specialist publisher, floated on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on Wednesday with a market capitalisation of around 5.0 million stg.
By 1200 GMT its shares, placed at 5p, were quoted at 6p, although no trade was registered in the stock.
Charterhouse was formed through a management buy-out backed by Schroder Ventures in 1988. Its titles include What Mortgage, What Investment, Personal Finance and Investment International.
Its recent acquisition of PBIP allowed it to move into publishing for finance industry professionals.
"We aim to continue our growth organically and through the acquisition of titles in related fields," said Charterhouse publishing director Geoff Gamble.
The adviser to the float was Teather and Greenwood and the broker was Ellis and Partners.
